# The data release of this report (set up by _results-main.Rmd)
data_statement <- local({
  if (!exists("benchmark_release_id")) return("Data: no benchmark release was loaded.")
  if (!isTRUE(benchmark_release_in_registry)) return(paste0("Data: custom benchmark catalog ", benchmark_release_id, "."))
  releases <- list_benchmark_releases()
  release  <- releases[releases$release == benchmark_release_id, ]
  paste0("Data: benchmark release ", benchmark_release_id, " (DOI ", release$doi, ", catalog SHA-256 ", release$catalog_sha256, ").")
})
